issues.detail: The Greek 'τρεχωμεν' is a present active indicative verb (we are running), but the Vietnamese uses an imperative construction ('hãy vứt bỏ... chạy'), changing the statement of fact into a command.
The Greek 'εχοντες' (having) is missing; the Vietnamese makes 'có một đám mây nhân chứng' a standalone clause rather than a participial modifier of 'chúng ta'.
